integrity: The closed formula is proved combinatorially from derivative zero-run coordinates and independently replayed on bounded finite instances. Finite replay is corroborative rather than the basis of the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one fixed-length tandem duplication only; no claim is made about multiple duplications, mixed lengths, degree sequences, or optimal code cardinalities.
title: Exact confusability edge count for one fixed-length tandem duplication
